verdict.rationale: Render documents environment variables, environment-group isolation between production and non-production, and OIDC-based short-lived credentials in place of long-lived API keys, which supports centralized secrets/config management. However, there is no evidence of team-level role-based access control, member invitation/permission management, or a dedicated secrets manager UI, so the 'team-level access' part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: team/RBAC management docs, explicit secrets-vault feature, multi-user permission controls.
